The co-expression modules from `01_Processing/06_Module_Building` are tested in the nine contrasts
of the protein fit in two ways. The eigengene test fits limma to each module's eigengene (one
number per biopsy). The set test runs fry on each module's proteins as a set, the way
`02_Set_Contrasts` tests gene sets. A third table describes, within each module, whether the
members that follow the module most closely are also the ones that changed most.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
library(here)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
source(here("00_Setup", "Shared_functions", "workbooks.R"))
inputs <- c(
  modules = "01_Processing/06_Module_Building/c_data/module_building.rds",
  fit = "02_HRvLR/01_Protein_Contrasts/c_data/protein_contrasts.rds"
)
paths <- vapply(inputs, here, character(1))
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
```

## Input

The eigengenes (module by biopsy) and membership, and the protein fit with its design, contrasts
and moderated t values.

```{r}
#| label: input
modules <- readRDS(paths[["modules"]])
saved <- readRDS(paths[["fit"]])
me <- modules$eigengenes
meta <- as_tibble(saved$fit$EList$targets)
contrasts <- colnames(saved$contrast_matrix)
members <- filter(modules$membership, module != "grey")
module_order <- modules$module_summary$module
stopifnot(identical(colnames(me), meta$sample_id), nrow(saved$design) == nrow(meta))
modules$module_summary
```

## Eigengene tests

Each eigengene goes through the protein design: one mean per group and time point plus the blood
index, person as a block. The within-person correlation is estimated on the eigengenes themselves
(`duplicateCorrelation()`), since they are the values fitted. limpa's sample weights belong to the
protein values and are not used here. `df` is limma's total degrees of freedom (the heatmap turns t
into an r-equivalent with it). `fdr` is Benjamini-Hochberg across modules within a contrast.

```{r}
#| label: eigengene-tests
me_correlation <- duplicateCorrelation(me, saved$design, block = meta$subject)$consensus.correlation
me_fit <- lmFit(me, saved$design, block = meta$subject, correlation = me_correlation) |>
  contrasts.fit(saved$contrast_matrix) |>
  eBayes(robust = TRUE)
eigengene_tests <- map(set_names(contrasts), \(cn) {
  topTable(me_fit, coef = cn, number = Inf, sort.by = "none", confint = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "module") |>
    transmute(
      module, logFC, logFC_lower = CI.L, logFC_upper = CI.R, t,
      df = me_fit$df.total[match(module, rownames(me_fit))], p = P.Value, fdr = adj.P.Val
    )
}) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "contrast")
c(within_person_correlation = round(me_correlation, 3))
slice_min(eigengene_tests, p, n = 5)
```

## Modules as protein sets

fry receives limpa's values and weights (`fit$EList`), the protein design, the contrast, the
person block and the within-person correlation of the protein fit. It asks whether a module's
proteins move together in the contrast, with people as the unit. `fdr` runs across modules within a
contrast.

```{r}
#| label: fry-tests
module_rows <- split(match(members$uniprot_id, rownames(saved$fit$EList)), members$module)
stopifnot(!any(map_lgl(module_rows, anyNA)))
fry_tests <- map(set_names(contrasts), \(cn) {
  fry(
    saved$fit$EList,
    index = module_rows, design = saved$design, contrast = saved$contrast_matrix[, cn],
    block = meta$subject, correlation = saved$fit$correlation, sort = "none"
  ) |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "module") |>
    transmute(module, n_proteins = NGenes, direction = Direction, p = PValue, fdr = FDR)
}) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "contrast")
slice_min(fry_tests, p, n = 5)
```

## Membership against protein change

Within each module, Spearman's rho between a member's kME (how closely it follows the eigengene)
and its moderated t in the contrast. A positive rho means the module's most central proteins moved
up most. Members were grouped by co-variation, so rho and its p describe the module; they do not
test it.

```{r}
#| label: membership
protein_t <- as_tibble(saved$eb$t, rownames = "uniprot_id") |>
  pivot_longer(-uniprot_id, names_to = "contrast", values_to = "t")
membership_contrast <- members |>
  inner_join(protein_t, by = "uniprot_id", relationship = "one-to-many") |>
  summarise(
    n_members = n(), rho = cor(kme, t, method = "spearman"),
    p = cor.test(kme, t, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value, .by = c(module, contrast)
  )
slice_max(membership_contrast, abs(rho), n = 5)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-module-tests
#| fig-cap: "Signed -log10 p per module and contrast; black border: FDR < 0.05; label: p < 0.05."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
bind_rows(
  eigengene = transmute(eigengene_tests, contrast, module, signed = -log10(p) * sign(t), p, fdr),
  fry = transmute(
    fry_tests, contrast, module,
    signed = -log10(p) * if_else(direction == "Up", 1, -1), p, fdr
  ),
  .id = "test"
) |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, rev(module_order)), contrast = factor(contrast, contrasts)) |>
  ggplot(aes(contrast, module, fill = signed)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_tile(data = \(d) filter(d, fdr < 0.05), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8, fill = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(p < 0.05, sprintf("%.3f", p), "")), size = 2.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", high = "#B2182B", name = "signed\n-log10 p") +
  facet_wrap(~test) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: validate
stopifnot(
  nrow(eigengene_tests) == nrow(me) * length(contrasts),
  nrow(fry_tests) == nrow(me) * length(contrasts),
  setequal(names(module_rows), rownames(me)),
  all(eigengene_tests$fdr >= eigengene_tests$p), all(fry_tests$fdr >= fry_tests$p),
  all(abs(membership_contrast$rho) <= 1)
)
```

## Summary

`r nrow(me)` modules in `r length(contrasts)` contrasts. Eigengene tests:
`r sum(eigengene_tests$p < 0.05)` at p < 0.05 and `r sum(eigengene_tests$fdr < 0.05)` at
FDR < 0.05. fry: `r sum(fry_tests$p < 0.05)` at p < 0.05 and `r sum(fry_tests$fdr < 0.05)` at
FDR < 0.05. Chance alone gives about `r round(nrow(me) * length(contrasts) / 20, 1)` per method at
p < 0.05. Within-person correlation `r round(me_correlation, 3)` on the eigengenes,
`r round(saved$fit$correlation, 3)` in the protein fit.

## Save

`module_contrasts.rds` holds the three tables for the figures.

```{r}
#| label: save
out <- here("02_HRvLR", "03_Module_Contrasts", "c_data")
dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(
  list(
    eigengene_tests = eigengene_tests, fry_tests = fry_tests,
    membership_contrast = membership_contrast
  ),
  file.path(out, "module_contrasts.rds")
)
write_workbook(
  list(
    eigengene_tests = eigengene_tests, fry_tests = fry_tests,
    membership_contrast = membership_contrast
  ),
  c(
    "limma on module eigengenes: logFC with 95% CI, moderated t, p, FDR across modules.",
    "fry on each module's proteins: direction, p, FDR across modules.",
    "Spearman rho between member kME and protein moderated t, per module and contrast."
  ),
  file.path(out, "module_contrasts.xlsx"), inputs, paths
)
```
